name: DARLA-02
source: NASA CubeSat Launch Initiative 15th-round selection announcement, 2024-03-18, https://www.nasa.gov/centers-and-facilities/kennedy/nasa-selects-new-round-of-candidates-for-cubesat-missions-to-station/; SmallSat 2024 DORRE paper, https://digitalcommons.usu.edu/smallsat/2024/all2024/33/
notes: Demonstration of Artificial Reasoning, Learning, and Analysis. NASA describes a 3U that demonstrates autonomous event response and maps radio-frequency background noise in the amateur UHF band. CSLI 15th-round flights are announced for 2025-2028. Specific filing dates are not in public records.

launchDate.note: Midpoint of the NASA CSLI 15th-round ISS launch window announced as 2025-2028 (NASA 2024-03-18). Exact launch date is not public.

deliveryDate.note: Two months before the estimated launch, typical CSLI-to-ISS delivery lead. Not in public records.

lvDeterminationDate.note: Five months before estimated delivery. Not in public records.

integrationDate.note: Six weeks before estimated delivery. Not in public records.

frequencyMHz.note: NASA states amateur UHF. 437.5 MHz is inside 47 CFR 97.207(c)(2) 435-438 MHz. Exact frequency not published.

apogeeKm.note: CSLI to ISS deployments are typically near 400 km. Exact orbit not in the selection announcement.

perigeeKm.note: Circular ISS-altitude estimate. Same basis as apogeeKm.

ballisticCoefficient.note: 3U CubeSat Bc about 180 kg/m^2, same 3U assumption as GT-1.

imagingEarth.note: NASA describes RF background-noise mapping in amateur UHF, not Earth imaging. NOAA CRSRA is not triggered.

pathway.note: NASA selection text: amateur ultra-high frequency band. Part 97 amateur pathway.
